map.加速试验到达终点时间 θₜ (天): Time to reach the endpoint in the accelerated test θ_t (days)
map.温度升高10℃反应速率增大的倍数，常见 2-3（水解/氧化反应）: The factor by which the reaction rate rises for a 10°C temperature rise, commonly 2-3 for hydrolysis and oxidation
map.ASLT 加速货架期试验：θₛ = θₜ × Q₁₀^((Tₜ − Tₛ)/10: ASLT accelerated shelf life test: θ_s = θ_t × Q₁₀^((T_t − T_s)/10). In other words a hot, short test extrapolates to a long, cool real storage period. Q₁₀ reflects how temperature affects the spoilage rate, and it differs by failure mechanism (microorganisms 3-5, oxidation 2-3).

map.加速老化外推常温保质期: Extrapolating room-temperature shelf life from accelerated ageing
map.常温保质期 θ_s = θ_t × Q₁₀^((T_t − T_s)/10)，θ: Room-temperature shelf life θ_s = θ_t × Q₁₀^((T_t − T_s)/10), where θ_t and T_t are the failure time and temperature under acceleration and T_s is the actual storage temperature.
map.37℃ 加速 30 天失效、Q₁₀=2、外推 25℃：θ_s=30×2^((37: 30 days to failure at 37°C with Q₁₀=2 extrapolated to 25°C: θ_s=30×2^((37−25)/10)=30×2^1.2≈68.9 days (about 2.3 months), which should be calibrated against the measured spoilage point.
map.多数食品变质 Q₁₀≈2–3，脂肪氧化可更高；应按产品与失效模式实验确定。: For most foods spoilage has Q₁₀ around 2-3 and fat oxidation can be higher; determine it experimentally per product and failure mode.
map.ASLT 结果能直接定标吗？: Can ASLT results set the label directly?
map.仅估算，正式保质期以实际温湿度长期存放与微生物/感官终点为准。: They are an estimate only; the official shelf life follows real long-term storage at the actual temperature and humidity with microbiological and sensory endpoints.
